title: feat(spec, formula, plugin-email, lint): a mail template formats an amount in the record's own currency with currency:@path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB2LLTurKiujTuz772H4neEX)_

Fixes #26660

Item (c) of the card landed in #26799. This PR lands item (b): a mail template formats an amount in the record's own currency, with the code read from the data.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #26940
ADR-0087: not-required — nothing stored changes meaning: `currency:@path` was refused at save and at render until now, so no stored template or built artifact carries it, and every form accepted before renders exactly as before.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 邮件模板新增 `{{ 金额 | currency:@currency_code }}` 写法:币种代码从发送数据里读,一个模板就能按每条记录自己的币种显示金额;站内模板(流程通知、按钮文案)对这个写法按名拒收。
- **为什么改:** hotclm 这类按合同发提醒的应用,金额币种各不相同;此前只能写死一个币种或只显示裸数字。
- **风险与回滚:** 只放宽了一个以前被拒的写法,旧写法与旧拒收全部不变;数据里没有合法代码(缺失、null、小写)时渲染报 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`,绝不用美元顶替。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts`(`@` 标记与方言判定)、`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`(取值与拒收)、`packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts`(声明变量检查)。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-currency-code-path.render.test.ts`,预期 12 个测试全过:EUR/CNY 两条记录在 en-US、zh-CN 两个语言行各自按本币显示,三种坏代码均报 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`。
- **需要你做的:** 本 PR 改了 `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`(受管面 Tier H),需要维护者批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule, in one sentence** (`CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE` in `@objectstack/formula`; the spec's `email_template` face descriptions, the lint rule's hint and every renderer refusal quote it): A `currency` argument is either a literal ISO 4217 code in three capital letters (`currency:EUR`) or, in a mail template only, `@` followed by a path into the send's data whose value is such a code (`currency:@currency_code`).

The `@` mark keeps the path form apart from the literal for every input: a literal code never starts with `@`, and no hole path does. So every shape refused today stays refused, including the #26799 pins `currency:currency_code` and `currency:record.currency_code`.

- **`@objectstack/formula`** (minor)
  - `currencyCodePath(formatterPart)` reads the marked form: `@` then a dotted path of word characters with no empty segment, unquoted, nothing between the mark and the path.
  - `judgeHoleFormatter` takes an optional dialect (`'in-app'` by default, `'mail'`). The mail dialect admits the marked form. The in-app dialect refuses it by name with the new rule `currency-code-path-mail-only` at compile and evaluate, so flow text slots, action and bulk-action copy, `titleFormat` and `promptTemplate` all refuse it (they refused it before as `currency-code-literal`).
  - `parseMailHole` carries the path as `codePath`. `judgeMailHoleGrammar(face, { variables })` refuses a marked path no declared variable names (itself, or a root it lies under), when the template declares any: rule `currency-code-path-undeclared`.
  - `currencyCodeValueRefusal(hole, path, value)` names a resolved value that is not an ISO 4217 code in three capitals exactly as stored.
  - `formatValue('currency', …)` is unchanged: it never reads a path, throws for a non-code argument, and formats in USD with no argument.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-email`** (minor): the renderer resolves the path against the send's data and formats in that code, in all three faces, double- or triple-braced. A missing, `null`, lowercase or other value throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID: email template NAME (locale=L): …`, naming the hole, the path and the value; nothing is sent. `email-service.ts` changes a comment only: its existing wrap already prefixes the template and locale.
- **`@objectstack/lint`** (minor): `email-template-hole-grammar` passes the template's declared `variables` to the judge, and its hint quotes the rule. `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the `email_template` publish door accept a well-formed marked path and refuse an undeclared one (`422 INVALID_METADATA` at the door).
- **`@objectstack/spec`** (minor, descriptions only): `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema` `subject`, `bodyHtml` and `bodyText` state the mail hole grammar (at most one formatter per hole, a second chained formatter refused) and the rule; `variables[].name` states the declared-path check. The descriptions promise no refusal of an unknown formatter name, because none exists today (see Acceptance notes). Reference docs regenerated (`content/docs/references/system/email-template.mdx`).
- **Docs and skill:** `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` teaches the form, the render refusal, the save-time checks and the in-app refusal. `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` gains two lines (below).

**Which dialects:** the mail dialect accepts `currency:@path`. The in-app dialect refuses it by name, because the doors that judge in-app text (`closedScopeTemplateRefusal`, the lint flow-path rules) check a hole's path against the roots a slot binds and never read an argument; accepting it there would let an argument's root reach the page unjudged. The three in-app spec describes (`flow-text-slot-template.ts`, `action-copy-template.ts`, `bulk-action.zod.ts`) stay true as written (they spell `currency:EUR` and `formatter[:arg]`), so they are unchanged.

## Why

Measured at `6090bb73` (post-#26799) through `EmailService.renderTemplate` and the lint rule: `{{ planned_amount | currency:currency_code }}` is refused at save (1 finding, `email-template-hole-grammar`) and at render (`TEMPLATE_INVALID … gives the currency formatter the argument 'currency_code'`) for both `currency_code: 'eur'` and `'EUR'`. So no mail template could show an amount in the record's own currency. Data roots: a mail template's holes read the send's `data` with bare roots (`planned_amount`, `contract.name`); the in-app engine's roots are `record`, `previous`, `input`, `user` / `current_user` / `ctx`, `os` plus each slot's `extra` (flow variables; action `record` / `params` / `result`; bulk `count` and params). A root-spelled argument (`currency:record.currency_code`) has no meaning in mail and is refused by an existing pin, and a bare path is ambiguous against the literal; a marked form fits both dialects.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/template-currency-code-path.test.ts` (new, 38): path reading (3 accepted, 10 rejected shapes); mail dialect admits and parses; malformed marks refused as `currency-code-literal` quoting the rule; declared-variable check (refused, exact, root, none declared, literal not judged); value refusal for missing / null / `eur` / `' EUR'` / number / object; in-app compile, `validateExpression` (`invalid-template`) and evaluate refuse by name; the formatter never reads a path; the spec's three face descriptions and the variable name description quote the rule (parity pin against the built spec).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-currency-code-path.render.test.ts` (new, 12): one bundle with `en-US` and `zh-CN` rows, records in `EUR` and `CNY`: `€1,234.50` / `CN¥1,234.50` (en-US) and `€1,234.50` / `¥1,234.50` (zh-CN) in every face; `sendTemplate` delivers two records in their own currencies; an unresolvable path, a lowercase code and a null code are each refused in both locales with the `TEMPLATE_INVALID: email template contract.overdue (locale=L)` prefix, the hole and the value, no `$` in the message, nothing sent; the literal form and the bare-path refusal unchanged.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.currency-path.test.ts` (new, 13): accepted with no variables and with declared path or root; undeclared refused per face; malformed marks refused; hint quotes the rule; each `os` command; the runtime publish gate accepts and refuses.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-writes.test.ts` (+1): through `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate`, an undeclared marked path is refused with `code` `INVALID_METADATA`, `status` 422 and the issue; the declared path and a no-variables template publish.
- The #26799 pins (`template-hole-grammar.test.ts`, `template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts`, `validate-email-template-hole-grammar.test.ts`, the door test's existing cases) are unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **`currency` with no argument still formats in USD** (not changed here, per the dispatch). Census at `6090bb73` of a no-argument `| currency` hole, generated files, CHANGELOGs and release notes excluded: examples 0, seeds 0, skills 0, apps 0; docs 2 (`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx:472`, `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx:79`, both in-app); spec describes and comments 4 (`flow-text-slot-template.ts:23`, `io-node-config.zod.ts:161`, `:632`, `:686`); service-automation 2 (`builtin/notify-node.ts:810`, `builtin/template.ts:104`); refusal and migration prose that spells it as an example 2 (`formula/src/template-engine.ts`, the invalid-hole message; `spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused.ts:24`); tests pinning the USD output 4 (`formula/src/template-formatters.test.ts:19`, `formula/src/template-hole-grammar.test.ts:114`, `plugin-email/src/template-engine.test.ts:79`, `plugin-email/src/template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts:110`), plus fixtures that only carry the hole (`lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.test.ts:28`, `lint/src/validate-expressions.text-slot.test.ts:122`, `ui/packages/app-shell/.../flowTextSlots.doubleBrace-11824.test.tsx:122`). No shipped template relies on it. Seat ruling: a separate narrowing card refuses a no-argument `currency` at authoring, filed as #26939 with this census.
- **Eval owed, filed as #26940** (not in this PR): `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` should ask for an `email_template` that shows an overdue amount in each contract's own currency, and expect `{{ amount | currency:@currency_code }}` (not a bare path, not a hard-coded code), the code stored in capitals, and the path declared when the template declares `variables`.
- **An unknown mail formatter is refused nowhere today:** `{{ x | nosuch }}` renders raw (`plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`). Not fixed here; filed as #26948. The spec descriptions were reworded in this PR so they do not promise that refusal.
- **In-app reading of a code from data** is not built: it would need the closed-scope root judges to read an argument's path. Noted, not filed.
- **Skills, governed:** `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` makes this PR Tier H (maintainer approval). File 471 → 473 lines, 5627 → 5668 tokens (ceiling 5997, headroom 329 after); the shipped SKILL.md set 4606 → 4608 lines; bundle total 213518 → 213559 tokens. The two lines are the only place a skill teaches a `currency` argument.
